answers.traditional_rag:
**Direct experimental evidence (in vitro)** – Icariin increased classic osteogenic markers in several cell‐based systems: in mouse MC3T3‑E1 pre‑osteoblasts it raised ALP activity, mineralized nodule formation and Runx2 protein without cytotoxicity up to 100 µM【27492554】; in the same line it enhanced proliferation, ALP, Runx2, BMP2 and OCN expression【29500883】. Human bone‑marrow MSCs showed dose‑dependent up‑regulation of ALP, BSPII and Runx2, and concurrent suppression of adipogenic genes (PPAR‑γ, C/EBP‑α)【33743412】. In MC3T3‑E1 cells icariin also elevated miR‑153 and Runx2, with luciferase confirmation of a miR‑153/Runx2 interaction【29904399】. Across these studies icariin’s effect was evident after 2–14 days of treatment, confirming a direct pro‑osteogenic action.

**In vivo animal evidence** – In an ovariectomy‑induced osteoporosis rat model, oral icariin or BMSC over‑expression of miR‑335‑5p (which icariin up‑regulated) restored bone micro‑architecture and reduced PTEN expression, indicating functional bone formation in vivo【35292240】. A separate rat model of steroid‑induced osteonecrosis showed that icariin prevented trabecular loss, lowered serum TM and VEGF, and normalized miR‑335‑5p levels in bone micro‑vascular endothelial cells【32911026】.
